info.title: PDFMint API
info.description: HTML, Markdown, URL and template rendering to PDF and images over a simple JSON API. The human-readable reference lives at https://pdf.mintapis.com/docs; this document is the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 description of the same endpoints. Authentication uses either `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`; keys start with `pm_live_`. Every authenticated endpoint is rate-limited to 120 requests per minute per account with a burst of 30 (headers X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Burst, X-RateLimit-Remaining; a 429 carries Retry-After). App-level errors that are not tied to one operation — `unknown_endpoint` (404), `invalid_json` (400), `request_too_large` (413) and `internal_error` (500) — are documented once in the top-level `x-app-level-errors` section; every operation-specific error code is listed on the operation it can hit.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account’s plan, monthly credit usage and when the period resets (on the 1st of the month, UTC).

post.summary: Render HTML, Markdown, a URL or a stored template to PDF
post.description: Costs 1 credit. Synchronous by default (binary/url/base64 output); with "async": true or a "webhookUrl" it queues a job instead and returns 202 with a status_url for GET /v1/jobs/{id}. Placeholders like {{name}} are filled from "data" and checked by strict mode.

schema.description: Exactly one content field must be set. Every PDF option below is accepted flat OR nested inside "options" (a flat key wins over the same key in "options").

html.description: HTML markup to render. May contain {{placeholders}} filled from "data".

markdown.description: Markdown to convert and render. May contain {{placeholders}}.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to render; private and link-local addresses are blocked.

template.description: Name of a stored template (see /v1/templates). Filled from "data"; its stored options are defaults overridden by the request.

data.description: Values for {{placeholders}}; an object, or a string containing JSON.

strict.description: Refuse (400) instead of returning a blank, placeholder-laden or escaped-markup document.

output.description: "binary" (default) returns the PDF bytes; "url" hosts the file and returns a temporary link; "base64" returns the bytes inside the JSON.

filename.description: Download name for binary output; ".pdf" is appended if missing.

options.description: PDF page options. On /v1/pdf they are accepted flat in the body or nested under "options" (flat wins on conflict); /v1/image and /v1/merge accept the same flat keys. Values are validated against src/options.js: unknown keys are refused, not ignored.

width.description: Custom page width; a number is treated as px. Requires "height".

height.description: Custom page height; a number is treated as px. Requires "width".

margin.description: A CSS length (default 12mm per side) or an object of per-side lengths. "" means 0 on every side.

headerHtml.description: Alias: "headerTemplate". Rendered on every page; enables header/footer mode.

footerHtml.description: Alias: "footerTemplate". Rendered on every page; enables header/footer mode.

pageNumbers.description: true builds a default "Page {page} of {total}" footer; a string is a template with {page}, {total}, {date}, {title}, {url}.

coverHtml.description: HTML for a cover rendered as the first page(s), ahead of the document. The cover gets NO header, footer or page numbers; content numbering starts at 1 with {total} counting content pages only. {{placeholders}} are filled from "data". Inherits javascript, emulateDarkMode and headers; "waitFor" applies to the content only. Cannot be combined with "pageRanges" (invalid_option).

timeout.description: Render timeout in ms; minimum 1000, capped at the server maximum (excess is clamped with a warning). Alias: "timeoutMs".

waitFor.description: Wait for a selector, a fixed delay, or network idle before printing. Aliases: "waitUntil", "wait", "delay".

javascript.description: Allow page JavaScript. Alias accepted on /v1/pdf only as a flat key.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers when rendering a "url".

css.description: Extra CSS (applied with "markdown"; honoured for html by the renderer).

googleFonts.description: Google Fonts to load before rendering.

password.description: Encrypt the PDF with this user password. Alias of "encrypt".

watermark.description: A watermark string, or {"text", ...}. Placeholders in "text" are filled from "data".

debug.description: Return page errors in the X-PDFMint-Page-Errors header and the JSON response.

expiresInMinutes.description: Hosted-file TTL in minutes for output "url" (clamped to the server minimum of 1 and maximum). Alias: "expiration".

async.description: Queue the render and return 202 with a job; poll GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

webhookUrl.description: Public URL notified when an async job finishes (implies async). Aliases: "webhook_url", "callback", "callbackUrl", "webhook".

title.description: Document title (used for the markdown conversion when no metadata title is set).

width.description: Custom page width; a number is treated as px. Requires "height".

height.description: Custom page height; a number is treated as px. Requires "width".

margin.description: A CSS length (default 12mm per side) or an object of per-side lengths. "" means 0 on every side.

headerHtml.description: Alias: "headerTemplate". Rendered on every page; enables header/footer mode.

footerHtml.description: Alias: "footerTemplate". Rendered on every page; enables header/footer mode.

pageNumbers.description: true builds a default "Page {page} of {total}" footer; a string is a template with {page}, {total}, {date}, {title}, {url}.

coverHtml.description: HTML for a cover rendered as the first page(s), ahead of the document. The cover gets NO header, footer or page numbers; content numbering starts at 1 with {total} counting content pages only. {{placeholders}} are filled from "data". Inherits javascript, emulateDarkMode and headers; "waitFor" applies to the content only. Cannot be combined with "pageRanges" (invalid_option).

200.description: The rendered document. Binary mode returns application/pdf bytes; url and base64 return JSON.

400.description:
`missing_content` — Nothing to render: send exactly one of "html", "markdown", "url" or "template".

`ambiguous_content` — More than one of "html", "markdown", "url" or "template" was sent.

`unknown_field` — The request contains a field the endpoint does not accept.

`invalid_option` — An option value is malformed or out of range.

`invalid_data` — The "data" field is a string but is not valid JSON.

`invalid_url` — The URL field is not a valid URL.

`unsupported_url_scheme` — The URL field must use http:// or https://.

`private_address_blocked` — The URL points at (or resolves to) a private, loopback or link-local address; SSRF is blocked.

`dns_failed` — The host in the URL could not be resolved.

`html_too_large` — The HTML exceeds the maximum document size.

`template_not_found` — No stored template with that name exists on this account.

`unresolved_placeholders` — The template uses placeholders that "data" does not provide (strict mode).

`invalid_placeholder_value` — A placeholder value would print as "[object Object]" (strict mode).

`blank_document` — The document has no visible content (strict mode).

`unrendered_markup` — The markup was printed as text instead of being applied (strict mode).

`file_too_large` — The generated file is over the hosted-file size limit; use output "binary".

post.summary: Render HTML, Markdown or a URL to a PNG or JPEG
post.description: Costs 1 credit. Screenshots the rendered page; saved templates are not supported here.

schema.description: Exactly one content field must be set ("template" is not supported for images). All fields are accepted flat or nested inside "options" (flat wins).

html.description: HTML markup to screenshot. May contain {{placeholders}} filled from "data".

url.description: Public http(s) URL to screenshot; private addresses are blocked.

type.description: Image format (aliases "format" and "imageType" are mapped to this field).

waitFor.description: Wait for a selector or a fixed delay. Aliases: "waitUntil", "wait", "delay".

timeout.description: Render timeout in ms; minimum 1000. Alias: "timeoutMs".

strict.description: Refuse blank or placeholder-laden screenshots with 400.

filename.description: Download name; the extension is corrected to match the type, with a warning when it lied.

200.description: The rendered image (image/png or image/jpeg for binary output; JSON for url/base64).

post.description: Costs 1 credit. Each input is a public http(s) URL, a base64 string, or {"base64": "..."}.

schema.description: Merges 2-50 PDFs. Inputs are accepted under "files" (also aliased as "urls" or "pdfs"); each entry is a public http(s) URL string, a base64 string, or {"base64": "..."}.

metadata.description: PDF metadata for the merged document.

strict.description: Refuse a merge whose pages would be empty with 400.

options.description: Accepted wrapper; its keys are folded into the body (flat keys win).

AppLevelError.description: The JSON error body the app-level handlers in the server answer with, on any request: the /v1/* 404 fall-through (`unknown_endpoint`), an oversized request body (`request_too_large`, 413), a body that is not valid JSON (`invalid_json`, 400) or an unhandled server fault (`internal_error`, 500). These codes are not tied to one operation; the full inventory with the status each handler answers with is in the top-level `x-app-level-errors` section.

Error.description: The error wire shape of src/errors.js: { error: { code, message } }, with optional hint, docs, details and request_id.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code, e.g. unknown_field.

hint.description: A concrete suggestion of what to change. Present when the error has one.

docs.description: Absolute URL of the relevant docs anchor. Present when the error has one.

details.description: Extra machine-readable facts, e.g. { unknown: [...] }. Present when the error has them.

request_id.description: The X-Request-Id of the request; quote it when reporting.

pages.description: Page count (absent/null when the PDF is encrypted).

url.description: Temporary hosted-file link (output "url", or the finished async job).

expires_in_minutes.description: How long the hosted link stays valid.

debug.description: Only on POST /v1/pdf with "debug": true and output url or base64: what the renderer saw while producing the page.

renderedHtml.description: The HTML of the page after placeholder filling; null if it could not be read back.

finalUrl.description: The page URL after redirects; "about:blank" when the source was html or markdown.

pageErrors.description: Up to 5 page errors (uncaught exceptions) the page produced; the same list is sent in the X-PDFMint-Page-Errors header.

job_id.description: Job ID, "job_" followed by base64url characters.

url.description: Present once succeeded: the hosted result file.

error.description: Present when the job failed or was cancelled.

code.description: The failure code. Any render-time code can land here (e.g. html_too_large, render_timeout, renderer_busy), plus job_cancelled for a cancelled job; src/jobs.js stores e.code || "render_failed".

x-app-level-errors.meaning: The path does not exist on this API; the /v1/* 404 fall-through answers this.
The request body is not valid JSON.
The request body is over the size limit the server accepts.
Something failed on the server while handling the request.
